title: Richard drives a F1 car round Silverstone - Top Gear
summary: Top Gear segment in which Richard Hammond drives a Renault R25 Formula 1 car around Silverstone for two laps. He struggles with the car's demands.
why: HN cites it as an illustration of how hard F1 cars are to drive, for example that they can't go slowly because of no downforce or tyre heat.

quote.text: he says it can't go slowly, safely - no downforce, no heat in the tyres, no heat in the brakes.
